terms.definition: A structured mention or external identifier resolves to a reference candidate.
A descriptor or catalog record describes a reference.
An exact inside/covered-by relationship under declared boundary semantics.
An exact contains/covers relationship under declared boundary semantics.
A distance-bounded relation with declared unit and distance model.
A coarse cover or index candidate that requires exact verification.
A position/reference is snapped to a directed network state.
A derived route plan relates start and destination references.
A derived plan covers required road obligations.
A time interval during which entities satisfy a proximity relation.
Evidence or events correlate with an external identifier or task.
A result evaluates an external predicate against world evidence.
A validation result evaluates a reference or result.
A validation result evaluates data snapshot currentness.
A catalog query discovers matching data products.
